notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
description:
At the beginning of combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Deal combat damage using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
